history.summary: A 581 sqft 1BR at $1.456M in Grand Dunman, a 1,008-unit mega-development 200m from Dakota MRT (CCL), TOP 2028. $2,506 PSF is roughly in line with the $2,458 URA project median (~+2%), and the huge unit count gives strong liquidity, though it is a leasehold new launch with forward pricing.
history.rating_rationale: Strong fundamentals on liquidity and location: 200m to Dakota MRT (Circle Line), one of the largest new developments in D15 (911 txns logged, very deep pool), prime East Coast/Dakota positioning, and a manageable $1.456M 1BR quantum. But $2,506 PSF prices it slightly ABOVE the project median ($2,458, ~+2%) rather than at a discount, and the rate carries new-launch bias with no resale basis. A 581 sqft 1BR in a 1,000+ unit project also faces heavy same-project rental/resale competition at TOP. Good asset, but bought at-or-above median with no margin of safety.
red_flags: $2,506 PSF is ~2% above the project URA median — no entry discount

catalysts: 200m to Dakota MRT (Circle Line) — premier transit adjacency
Mega-development scale (~1,008 units) = strong long-run liquidity
Prime D15 Dakota/East Coast location with deep owner-occupier and tenant demand
